specs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: architectural interior design concept, photographic.
Input image1 is the EDIT TARGET and ONLY camera/geometry anchor, from the actual v19 main model. Image2 is the homeowner's selected photographic style screenshot, image3 its clean style companion. Transfer their convincing material response, fabric, daylight and optical realism only. NEVER copy their old TV border, ceiling fixtures, bookcase grid, furniture positions or screenshot UI.
Primary request: natural modern Japanese interior, clean matte warm-white walls and pale low-yellow oak, greige fine linen. Small deep-walnut accents on table/chair legs and inside the bookcase recess, sage and navy textiles. Keep existing milk-yellow lower corridor cabinets and cream white uppers. Real wood grain, restrained reflections, soft upholstery with seams and cushion tension, grounded shadows, subtle material imperfections and photographic tonal gradients. Avoid orange/yellow wash, cartoon/CGI/plastic or uniform lighting.
V19 design locks: TV wall is COMPLETELY PLAIN warm-white paint, with 85-inch TV and floating oak low cabinet; NO decorative border, wood frame, wall panel, gold lines, TV halo, stone feature or art on TV wall. The flat continuous suspended ceiling has no central living main light and no arbitrary new vents/fixtures; AC positions are not finalized. Curtain cove and selected cabinet lighting only where shown. Bookcase is now white full-height to ceiling: retain closed 800mm base and two side towers, central dark-walnut-backed open band800–2150 with TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, then closed upper storage2150–2750. Sparse books in six bays, no additional display collection. Dining has ONE600x350 oval paper/linen diffuse pendant, bottom1500, one900x600 abstract sage/navy artwork on the dining wall, and FOUR slim dark-walnut curved-back chairs (two sage seats, two greige).
Preserve all walls, openings, glazing divisions, full ceiling/curves, concealed trim, furniture count, footprints and orientations. Preserve the chaise at BALCONY end, coffee table, separate ottoman; double desk behind sofa facing TV with exactly ONE34-inch monitor, ONE office chair, lamp, pen cup, water cup and small plant; balcony low round tea table with TWO LOW chairs; three floor plants and stacked washer/dryer. No rug, extra sofa, stool, display props, new windows, additional wall lighting or furniture. Entry on entering from plan left toward right: RIGHT short wall full-height shoe cabinet, two door columns, niche at1200–1400 and bottom gap160, NO seat/hooks; LEFT end of long cabinet is1000mm padded bench at450 high, pale oak piano-key foldable hook wall20columns in3bands/four projecting keys at ends, white upper storage to ceiling. Preserve these exact sides and opening.
No text, labels, watermark, people or controls. Exact object geometry remains source-authoritative; outside is illustrative trees/sky, not actual site photography.
PERSPECTIVE LOCK: preserve image1 aspect ratio, framing, camera position and lens. Straight architectural photography, not fisheye. Daylight interior photograph: believable oblique soft sunlight and gradual light falloff, detailed bright tree/sky outlook and calm interior shadows. Do not preserve the underexposure of source render. Keep source camera and geometry exactly. Portrait framing identical to image1; show the actual cabinet full-height relationship, not a new room or wider view.
